viewer-refresh: Follow the exact refresh rate of the display the viewer's window is on
decoder-install-hints: Suggest the decoder install that would give a viewer a better codec
viewer-scroll: Scroll one host notch per wheel notch, with fine and momentum scrolling
mac-vt-padded-capture: Capture unaligned Mac sizes into a 16-padded surface cropped in the SPS
encoder-throughput-cap: Cap the pace at the encoder's throughput when units queue four deep
host-direct-bbr: Measure BBR against Cubic on the host's direct QUIC, and keep Cubic
linux-video-plane: Add an opt-in GTK GL video plane to the Linux viewer
mac-viewer-enhance: Add optional GPU sharpening of an enlarged picture to the Mac viewer
linux-plane-scaling: Scale the Linux video plane's picture by area and sharpen it on request
